The impurity level sits at the real energy $\epsilon$, and its bare propagator is
\begin{equation}
G_0(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega - \epsilon} .
\label{eq:g0}
\end{equation}
The band dispersion $\epsilon(k)$ is even because of time-reversal symmetry,
\begin{equation}
\epsilon(-k) = \epsilon(k) .
\label{eq:even}
\end{equation}
